Title: Honor the Elders vs. Blood Cult Awareness Network

Messages.Author: firstco...@aol.com
Messages.Body:
LSJ:
Is Honor the Elders an action which moves blood to the uncontrolled
region, and therefore at -1 stealth? Or does its conditionality stop
it from being considered as such?

Further, if its conditionality prevents it from being considered such,
is it because it might not pass, and therefore is a successful action
which did not move blood to the uncontrolled region? Or is it because
there might not be any vampires in the uncontrolled region of capacity
>7? Perhaps either would be reason enough.

-- Brian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
firstco...@aol.com wrote:
> LSJ:
> Is Honor the Elders an action which moves blood to the uncontrolled

> region, and therefore at -1 stealth [if Blood Cult Awareness Network is
> in play]? Or does its conditionality stop it from being considered as such?

Like directability, the fact that it is a referendum is the breaking
point.
So it is still at the normal stealth, unaffected by Blood Cult
Awareness Network.

> Further, if its conditionality prevents it from being considered such,
> is it because it might not pass, and therefore is a successful action
> which did not move blood to the uncontrolled region? Or is it because
> there might not be any vampires in the uncontrolled region of capacity
> >7? Perhaps either would be reason enough.

Perhaps. But just the referendum part (even if it is set to pass
automatically) is sufficient.
